source: Illustrative fixture; no real account, Galaxy artifact, session, or execution evidence.

stages.title: Identify reference cohorts
stages.label: Inventory written
stages.summary: The reference repository and 42-cohort inventory were recorded. This establishes the intended input set, not successful validation of all 42 cohorts.
stages.evidence: Example evidence: The notebook records the pinned reference snapshot and uploaded source and cohort manifests.
stages.next: Compare the accepted and rejected cohort IDs with the frozen reference inventory before declaring completeness.

stages.title: Preserve original inputs
stages.label: Archive imported
stages.summary: A 22.4 MB archive containing the reference inputs reached Galaxy. An earlier upload was rejected because the requested datatype was unsupported.
stages.evidence: Example evidence: At 19:35:49 UTC, Galaxy returned the archive in state ok with 22,379,374 bytes. Byte preservation still requires the checksum comparison.
stages.next: Verify the original archive checksum against the source manifest; successful upload alone is insufficient.

stages.title: Prepare & validate inputs
stages.label: Job finished
stages.summary: The batch preparation job finished on Galaxy and returned four output datasets. Tool completion does not establish that every cohort passed validation.
stages.evidence: Example evidence: The notebook's job record reports Galaxy state ok at 19:48:38 UTC. Subsequent dataset detail calls returned the validation and consumer reports.
stages.next: Read the generated reports and inspect per-cohort outcomes, extraction checks, and any rejected inputs.

stages.title: Verify Galaxy outputs
stages.label: Needs verification
stages.summary: Galaxy output metadata is available. The captured evidence does not establish that the input package meets all requested validation and collection requirements.
stages.evidence: Example evidence: Validation report: 30,453 bytes. Consumer report: 310 bytes. Cohort manifest: 43 lines. These metadata checks establish availability, not scientific correctness.
stages.next: Inspect report contents, reconcile all 42 study IDs, verify taxon/date parity and hashes, and confirm the required Galaxy collections exist.

stages.title: Deliver reusable inputs
stages.label: Not yet verified
stages.summary: A reproducibility archive was produced, but the full handoff has not been established by this snapshot. No full example molecular-clock benchmark was verified here.
stages.evidence: Example evidence: An archive dataset is recorded. Collection correspondence, executable workflow exports, and the completed handoff contract still need evidence.
stages.next: After verification, link the accepted collections, workflow, archive and notebook; report any missing or blocked cohorts explicitly.

issues.title: Reference inventory was read as the wrong JSON shape
issues.impact: The inspection script expected an object, but the manifest is a list.
issues.action: A later inventory was written. This snapshot does not independently verify that the parsing repair preserved every cohort.

issues.title: Shell quoting broke the source-extraction script
issues.impact: The command failed before its regular expression could be evaluated correctly.
issues.action: Inspect the later source manifest against the pinned source records; a subsequent command succeeding does not establish extraction parity.
issues.excerpt:
/bin/bash: command substitution: syntax error near unexpected token
/bin/bash: command substitution: line 0: `?([^'

issues.title: Galaxy rejected the upload datatype “binary”
issues.impact: That upload request failed with HTTP 400. The target server does not accept binary as a file_type option.
issues.action: Workaround observed: the original inputs were subsequently imported as a tar.gz archive; Galaxy reported it ok at 19:35:49. Integrity verification remains separate.
issues.excerpt:
Unexpected HTTP status code: 400
Parameter 'file_type': an invalid option ('binary') was selected.

issues.title: An extraction test could not import its helper
issues.impact: The local test stopped because alignment_test_helper was unavailable.
issues.action: Confirm that the Galaxy output reports provide the intended extraction checks; this failed test is not verification evidence.

issues.title: Engine-parity check stopped: NumPy was missing
issues.impact: The local parity test could not load the engine parser.
issues.action: Engine ingestion remains unverified by this attempt. It needs a successful check in the intended Galaxy runtime.

issues.title: A published date contained a thousands separator
issues.impact: The preparator could not convert the value 1,710.0 to a number.
issues.action: Inspect the generated comparator values and their units to confirm the repair did not change their meaning.
issues.excerpt: ValueError: could not convert string to float: '1,710.0'

issues.title: The cohort manifest builder used an undefined variable
issues.impact: The local script stopped while assembling the manifest rows.
issues.action: A manifest was later produced. Verify its exact cohort IDs and statuses rather than treating file creation as proof of correctness.
